localized.zh_cn: 破盾升级已修正：无耐久的符文护甲也能触发破盾效果；仍只激活首槽，可右击轮换。属性加成仅在正确穿戴槽生效。
localized.en_us: Shield-breach upgrades now work on durability-free runic armor. Only the first slot triggers; right-click to rotate it. Attribute bonuses require the correct armor slot.

localized.en_us: Upgrade ingredients require the actual modern potions: Splash Harming II, Strength II and extended Regeneration.

localized.en_us: The Mask of Cruelty requires sustained, unobstructed sight within 24 blocks and respects PvP, teams and attack protection.
